Made for the open road.

An original browser driving world. The world layout is generated locally in code. All nine drivable cars, moving traffic and parked cars use the credited real-car models below.

Ferrari 458 Italia

3D model by vicent091036, distributed in the official Three.js car example under CC BY 4.0. The game expands and simplifies the geometry for browser performance, adapts materials, wheel pivots and placement for driving, and adds a painted coupe roof and rear glazing. Full attribution and modifications.

Eight more real cars

  • 1975 Porsche 911 (930) Turbo — by Lexyc16. Original model.
  • Nissan Skyline R34 GT-R — by Lexyc16. Original model.
  • Toyota Corolla AE86 Sprinter Trueno — by Lexyc16. Original model.
  • BMW E36 M3 Coupe — by Martin Trafas. Original model.
  • 2013 Lamborghini Aventador LP700-4 Roadster — by _shobh19. Original model.
  • 2020 BMW X6 M Competition — by SharkyStudios. Original model.
  • 1983-1987 Toyota Corolla KE80 Sedan — by PHAC. Original model.
  • 2018 Lamborghini Urus — by Kai Xiang. Original model.

Models and preview images: CC BY 4.0, distributed by Carros. The game normalizes orientation and scale, rigs wheels, adapts materials and derives light traffic and distant meshes from the original geometry. Full attribution and modification details. Source and license provenance.

Environment photography

Photographed surfaces and outdoor HDR lighting by Poly Haven, available under CC0.

  • Asphalt 02 — road color, normal and roughness maps.
  • Brown Mud Leaves 01 — terrain color and normal maps.
  • Kloppenheim 06 Pure Sky — environment reflections.

Additional wall, sand and rock photographs: Brick Wall 001, White Plaster Rough 02, Concrete Wall 001, Aerial Beach 01 and Rock Boulder Dry.

Engine audio

Racing car engine sound loops by domasx2, CC0. Volume-normalized and mixed with generated horn, ignition, nitro, shift, impact, surface, wind and tire effects. Nearby traffic uses distance, stereo pan and relative-velocity pitch. This is a game engine sound, not a Ferrari-specific recording.

Built with

Three.js 0.180.0, GLTFLoader, BufferGeometryUtils and HDRLoader, MIT license. Barlow typefaces, SIL Open Font License.

All game assets are served with the game. The garage, paint, graphics settings and discoveries are saved only in your browser.
